board.source: Edge.Cuts gr_rect, absolute (62.5,60) to (107.5,100) in the pcb file

keepouts.name: antenna_keepout
keepouts.reason: U4's ESP32-C3-MINI-1 footprint carries its own "antenna keepout" zone (polygon in the pcb file, absolute (62.5,59.9)-(75.7,65.3)), already flush with the board's top and left edges. 0mm overhang beyond this zone is a PLACEHOLDER - the Espressif datasheet is the authority on required clearance, not this file. The y1=-0.1 is the zone's own geometry bleeding 0.1mm past the drawn edge; not something I added.

groups.name: mcu
groups.description: ESP32-C3-MINI-1, the reference every other group's nets lead back to.

groups.name: regulator
groups.description: U3 (AP2112K 3.3V LDO) and its caps. No cap exists on its VIN net (/VBAT_SW) in the file - only an output cap.

groups.name: charger
groups.description: U2 (MCP73831), its caps, its PROG resistor, D1 (STAT LED) and D1's resistor. J2 (battery connector) added here - its nets (/VBAT, GND) land directly on U2 pin 3.

groups.name: usb
groups.description: J1 (USB-C) and the two CC resistors.

groups.name: esp32_support
groups.description: EN pull-up, EN cap, SW6 (RESET), SW7 (BOOT), GPIO2 pull-up, GPIO8 pull-up, 3V3 caps.

groups.name: sensing
groups.description: Battery divider (R8/R9) and its cap (C1), on /VBAT_SENSE, near U4 GPIO3 (pad 6).

groups.name: display
groups.description: J3 (OLED header), near U4's SDA/SCL pins (pads 18/19).

groups.name: user_io
groups.description: SW2 (BTN2), SW5 (BTN1), D2 (debug LED) and its resistor.
